title: Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and Comptroller
organization: Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University (RLBCAU)
application_fee: Rs 1000 for General/OBC, Rs 500 for ST/SC/PwBD, Women candidates exempted
age_limit: Preferably below 57 years for Professor/Comptroller, 47 years for Associate Professor, and 40 years for Assistant Professor as on last date of advertisement

important_dates.label: Date of commencement of online application
Last date of receiving print out of application with documents

summary: Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University (RLBCAU) has issued an advertisement for regular Statutory and Teaching positions including Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and Comptroller across various disciplines. Eligible candidates must apply online through the official website and submit the printed hard copy along with supporting documents by post before the stipulated deadline.
eligibility_bullets: Comptroller: Master's degree with at least 55% marks and requisite years of administrative/teaching experience.
Professor/Associate Professor: Doctoral degree in relevant subject with extensive research/teaching experience and published works.
Assistant Professor: Master's degree with at least 60% marks along with NET qualification or Ph.D. degree in the relevant discipline.
how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official university website at www.rlbcau.ac.in and read the detailed notification.
Fill out the online application form for the desired post with correct details and pay the application fee online.
Take a printout of the completed online application form along with all uploaded enclosures and required documents.

Send the hard copy through Indian postal service to the Registrar, Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University, Gwalior Road, Jhansi-284003, superscribing the envelope with the post name and post code.
